data.name: ShapeName
data.comment: Name of the segmented control that picks the shape (the prototype calls it Shape).

data.name: FitName
data.comment: Name of the segmented control that picks Fit or Fill.

data.name: ShapeMatch
data.comment: The first shape, as the segment shows it: the shape of the photos themselves.

data.name: ShapeMatchName
data.comment: The first shape, as a screen reader names it.

data.name: FitOption
data.comment: The first Fit or Fill choice: the whole photo, with bars where the shapes differ.

data.name: FillOption
data.comment: The second Fit or Fill choice: the frame is filled and the edges are cut.

data.name: FitHint
data.value: Fit shows the whole photo with bars where shapes differ.
data.comment: The line under the controls when Fit is chosen.

data.name: FillHint
data.value: Fill crops the edges so the frame has no bars.
data.comment: The line under the controls when Fill is chosen.

data.name: MatchingPhotos
data.comment: Match photos is chosen and the photos' sizes are known. {0}: the width, {1}: the height of the most common photo.

data.name: MatchingNoPhotos
data.value: Matching your photos. Until their sizes are known the shape is 16:9.
data.comment: Match photos is chosen but no photo size is known yet (no photos, or none read), so the video is 16:9.

data.name: NoSize
data.value: Photos this wide or tall are too large to export on this PC. Pick a fixed shape such as 16:9.
data.comment: Match photos gives a shape so wide or tall that no size can be exported on this PC; says what to do instead.

data.name: PortraitHint
data.value: Most of your photos are portrait, so 9:16 suits them better.
data.comment: The quiet line when most photos are portrait and the shape is landscape.

data.name: PortraitApply
data.comment: The button that applies the suggestion.

data.name: PortraitDismiss
data.comment: The button that closes the suggestion for the project.

data.name: Announcement
data.comment: Said to a screen reader after a change. {0}: the shape's name, {1}: Fit or Fill.
